goal: Stop recurring Tor connection failure warnings in logs on nodes where Tor is not configured
Log an informational message when an established onion service connection drops unexpectedly
agreement: Tested support for reducing log noise and restoring pre-v32 behavior (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Concept support for moving noisy connection logs behind a debug category (ismaelsadeeq)
Open suggestion to mention Tor explicitly in the warning message to avoid confusion (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it eliminates roughly 18 lines of spurious warnings per hour on default nodes not running Tor
Also alerts node operators with an informational log when an active onion service connection drops
